name: AUTOPILOT.OI Subscription Agent
description_html:
Find every subscription you forgot and cut the ones you don't use.

A Claude agent that reads your statements, finds every recurring charge (even renamed ones, yearly renewals and app store charges), flags trials that turned paid and price increases, shows cheaper options, drafts cancel messages and the dispute letter if a company keeps billing you.

What you get (12 page agent pack, PDF): a setup builder that installs the agent with you, setup questions, full agent instructions, the worked example from our reel, templates and a tracker.

How it works: it runs inside a Claude Project. It finds, compares and drafts; you decide and cancel. It does not log into your accounts or cancel anything on its own.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works) and 3 months of statements with full numbers blacked out.

Education only, not financial advice. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
